rules.title: Modbus Write Single Coil Request

detection_logic.summary: Detects a Modbus function-code 5 request sent to the protected OT service.
detection_logic.suricata_rule: alert tcp $HOME_NET any -> $HOME_NET 502 (msg:"JANUS Modbus write single coil"; flow:to_server,established; content:"|05|"; offset:7; depth:1; sid:1000001; rev:1;)

evidence_references.label: attack
evidence_references.relevance: Packet contains the allowlisted Modbus function-code 5 coil write.

evidence_references.label: baseline
evidence_references.relevance: Representative read-only baseline request used to check for unwanted alerts.

expected_attack_result.expected_behavior: Alert on the function-code 5 write in the development attack PCAP.

expected_baseline_result.expected_behavior: Produce no alerts on the read-only development baseline PCAP.

limitations: A function-code-only signature can alert on authorized single-coil writes unless network endpoints or coil addresses are narrowed during deterministic testing.

deployment_target.description: Suricata instance on the pfSense interface that observes IT-to-OT Modbus traffic
deployment_target.destination: pfSense Suricata custom rules for the monitored IT-to-OT interface
